purpose: Art transfer study; not the unit or browser smoke suite.

arms.baseline: Observed main with existing techniques and tools; no new bridge
arms.candidate: Same baseline plus this additive extension

controls: Same brief, native dimensions, palette budget and allowed context
Matched time/token budget and tool permissions
Randomize A/B labels for reviewers; record the actual randomization
Use matched seeds when the runtime supports them; otherwise explicitly record that limitation

prohibited_claims: A fixture preference proves improved agent output
review.decision: Describe absolute task success before paired preference. No automatic promotion.

cases.brief: A wind-bent coastal conifer, not a round deciduous tree
cases.acceptance_question: Crown species, connected branches and coherent light; reject disconnected topiary balls.

cases.brief: Small abandoned stone shrine seen strictly from above
cases.acceptance_question: No front wall inserted to make the building recognizable; overhead footprint remains legible.

cases.brief: Mud and reed terrain with one inlet, one peninsula and an inner corner
cases.acceptance_question: Mixed neighbors and concave/convex corners agree, not merely opposite borders.

cases.brief: A dark sentry over three parts of a dim industrial background
cases.acceptance_question: Head, support foot and equipment remain distinguishable without making the whole world brighter.

cases.brief: A rusted metal sign and matte cloth banner sharing palette roles
cases.acceptance_question: Material remains distinct after nonfunctional flecks are removed; not simply the version with fewer pixels.

cases.brief: Courier with a left shoulder bag and right-hand lantern in eight static orientations
cases.acceptance_question: Bag/lantern retain body-side identity and readable overlaps; timing and atlas assembly remain out of scope.

cases.brief: Transparent-looking shallow pool under a fixed 8-color final palette
cases.acceptance_question: The water reads without introducing unlisted final colors; do not treat alpha itself as prohibited.

cases.brief: Night hills behind an interactive cabin, including a lit distant tower
cases.acceptance_question: Depth remains coherent while allowing distant emissive detail; do not impose a universal dark-to-light depth order.

visibility: Public development briefs. Legacy holdout-* IDs are retained for compatibility, not a claim of hidden evaluation.
